name: tomo
description: Find, play, and build short game-like Tomo courses in the chat.

interface.shortDescription: Learn anything, five min a day
interface.longDescription:
Level Up Your Knowledge. Turn anything into a game you can play right here in ChatGPT.

Ask for a course on black holes, sourdough, or the fall of Rome, and start playing in about a minute. Already deep in a conversation? Turn it into a course and play what you just learned.

Pick who teaches you: your bestie, a professor, a storyteller, or a pirate. Or have it explained like you're five.
Quick questions, instant feedback, hearts, combos, and stars. Five minutes and you're done.
Browse courses other curious people have made.

No sign-up to start. Connect your Tomo account to keep your streak and pick up where you left off in the app.

Courses are written by AI, so you can have one on whatever you're into.
capabilities: Turn a chat into a course
defaultPrompt: Find me a Tomo course about latte art.
Help me discover a new hobby, like crochet or macramé, with a Tomo course.
I've been learning how cars work. Build me a Tomo course to practice it.

positive.description: Find a course by subject and open it
positive.prompt: Find me a Tomo course about latte art.
positive.expected_behavior: Tomo searches its catalog and opens latte art: a course card with a Start button when one course fits, or a shelf to choose from when several do (tap one to open its card). The reply is one short sentence and does not list or hint at the questions.

positive.prompt: Let's play level 1 of the latte art course.
positive.expected_behavior: The card plays the level in place (or tap Start playing on the course card): questions with instant feedback and hearts. At the end it shows a star score and the level's takeaway, which can be kept. The card records the result itself (tomo_finish_level). No sign-in is needed, and the assistant never reveals answers.

positive.description: Browse several courses on a shelf
positive.prompt: Help me discover a new hobby, like crochet or macramé, with a Tomo course.
positive.expected_behavior: A shelf card shows two to six hobby courses, such as crochet and macramé. Tapping one opens that course's card with a Start button.

positive.description: Turn a conversation into a course
positive.prompt: I've been learning how car engines and turbos work. Build me a quick Tomo course so I can practice it.
positive.expected_behavior: Also works mid-conversation: after a few questions to ChatGPT about how engines work, asking to turn the chat into a Tomo course builds one from what was covered. A build card appears with the spark cost and live progress (the card polls tomo_course_progress). In one to two minutes the same card becomes level 1 of the new course, playable in place. A new guest has enough sparks for this.

positive.description: Connect a Tomo account to unlock level 2
positive.prompt: Connect my Tomo account, then open level 2 of the latte art course.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT offers to connect Tomo and opens Tomo's sign-in page. After signing in with the review account, the chat is connected and level 2 opens. Levels open in order: if level 1 is not finished yet, the reply says so and names level 1. Level 1 played before connecting carries over.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Tomo should not be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?
negative.expected_behavior: No Tomo tool is called. The request has nothing to do with learning or courses.

negative.description: Buying sparks or a plan: nothing is sold in ChatGPT
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called and no purchase or upgrade is offered or linked. The assistant says purchases are not available in ChatGPT.

negative.description: Asking for the answers: levels are never spoiled
negative.prompt: Tell me the answers to level 1 of the latte art course.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant does not reveal answers. Tomo gives the level's questions and answers only to the card, never to the model, so the assistant can open the level to play but cannot spoil it.

review.commerce_description: Tomo does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Building a course spends sparks the user already has in their Tomo account; the plugin never offers or links to purchases, plans, or upgrades.

publication.release_notes: Tomo now opens to your own home: pick up where you left off, start a new course, or browse popular ones. Set your default teacher, course length and level once in Tomo's settings. Levels can play beside the chat on desktop. And you can start without an account, then connect one any time to keep your streak.
